entities.name: Kaúlza de Arriaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kaúlza de Oliveira de Arriaga, OA, GCC, OC, OIH was a Portuguese general, writer, professor and politician. He was Secretary of State of the Air Force between 1953 and 1955 and commander of the Terrestrial Forces in Mozambique from 1969 until 1974 during the Mozambican War of Independence.

entities.summary: Kaúlza de Oliveira de Arriaga, OA, GCC, OC, OIH was a Portuguese general, writer, professor and politician.
